Name: Jehiel, Overseer
Summary: Jehiel was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes, at the commandment of Hezekiah and Azariah ruler of the house of God.
KeyStory: Jehiel was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes, at the commandment of Hezekiah and Azariah ruler of the house of God.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, the Levite; Shimei, Brother of Cononiah; King Hezekiah; Azariah, Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Many overseers together kept one storehouse honest.
